summary: The parent organization emphasizes the need for meaningful parental consent and opt-out rights, clarifies the separation of broadband access from educational technology issues, and expresses concern about potential budget cuts if e-rate is reduced or eliminated.

claims.argument: Reduced funding could force districts to cut other programs
claims.evidence_quote: If e-rate is reduced or eliminated, we are concerned that the reduction in federal subsidies will force districts to cut other programs to make up any budget deficit.
